care.summary: Elegant, slow-growing tree with thin arching leaves edged in red; one of the easiest indoor trees.
care.light: Bright indirect light; tolerates low light
care.water: Allow top 50% of soil to dry between waterings
care.humidity: Moderate; mist occasionally in dry air
care.fertilizer: Balanced liquid fertilizer monthly spring through fall
common_issues: Brown leaf tips from fluoride or low humidity
tips: Remove lower leaves as trunk grows for a tree-like appearance
Sensitive to fluoride - use distilled water
